source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Describe the brake rotors and pads.
3. Discuss the condition of the brake lines.
4. Discuss the condition of the master cylinder.
5. Note brake pedal feel.
6. Be specific about the test failure.
7. Include measurements when possible.
8. Note any other brake system components.
9. Document all findings.
10. Review and sign.

You can find more details here: [https://vehicleinspection.com/document-failed-brake-tests-vehicle-inspection-report/](https://vehicleinspection.com/document-failed-brake-tests-vehicle-inspection-report/)<end_of_turn>
